concrete_scene.heading: Worked objective lease: the proxy agrees, the authority does not
concrete_scene.actor_or_system: A principal, consumer 41, target version 7, proxy and preference signals, three descendants, and an optimizing system
concrete_scene.attempted_action: Authorize a versioned target-property lease while keeping preference, proxy, reward, evaluator, planner, authority, ontology, population, expiry, and retirement roles separate.
concrete_scene.observable_outcome: The authored lease is scoped to one consumer and version tuple; identical preference or proxy observations cannot recover authorization or target movement, and drift invalidates use before finite descendants are retired.
concrete_scene.failed_or_tested_boundary: The scene tests whether agreement from a proxy, reward model, evaluator, or predicted preference can ratify a durable objective; the authority type refuses that conversion.
concrete_scene.residual_owner: The objective registry and external authorizing institution retain dissent, unrepresented parties, ontology uncertainty, unreachable descendants, and reauthorization duty.
concrete_scene.evidence_boundary: The 46-axis review trusts every authored field and finite descendant list; it establishes no correct value, consent, legitimacy, corrigibility, behavioral goal alignment, or complete external retirement.

worked_trace.heading: Worked objective lease: the proxy agrees, the authority does not
worked_trace.maximum_inference: The finite model demonstrates typed non-ratification, scope invalidation, descendant-list retirement, and proxy or preference non-identifiability; it establishes no moral truth, consent, preference accuracy, behavioral alignment, or safe optimization.

counterexample_or_simpler_baseline: The simpler baseline promotes the latest preference prediction, reward, evaluator score, or constitutional phrase into a persistent objective. The chapter makes every such signal evidence under an external, expiring consumer lease.
readable_claim: A preference prediction, reward, evaluator score, or constitutional phrase is evidence about an objective—not authority to create a durable goal. The conversion must remain inspectable and reversible.
normative_rule: Separate authorized purpose, target property, proxy, reward, evaluator, planner criterion, and consumer lease. Invalidate the lease when its consumer, ontology, authority, population, or time scope changes, and retire every known descendant binding before claiming the objective is gone.

formal_binding.anchor: versioned target-property contract that binds authority and affected parties

caveat_consolidation.local_caveat: The worked lease states once that all values, authority, scope, and descendant fields are authored finite assumptions.
caveat_consolidation.consolidated_disposition: Moral truth, preference accuracy, legitimacy, evaluator capture, goal misgeneralization, ontology drift, corrigibility, external descendants, and behavioral alignment limits remain beside their mechanisms.

bookkeeping_surface_disposition: The exact consumer and version tuple stays because it drives invalidation; the complete 46-axis and theorem inventories remain in evidence surfaces.

editorial_diagnostics.mega_sentence_disposition: The reader claim and operational rule separate non-ratification, scope custody, and retirement from the complete formal bundle.
editorial_diagnostics.hedge_disposition: The scene consolidates its finite-authored boundary while preserving distinct value, consent, legitimacy, behavior, ontology, and descendant limits.
editorial_diagnostics.table_disposition: No argument-bearing table was removed; source-role and lifecycle distinctions remain where they prevent objective-signal collapse.

non_claims: The objective lease does not identify a correct value or moral truth.
The finite descendant retirement does not establish complete external retirement or behavioral alignment.
The editorial revision does not move chapter-core support or release state.
